baselines.gbz_load_behavior: The complete compressed GBZ is deserialized before interval queries; cold object access therefore requires the whole object.
baselines.gbz_query_limitations: GBZ is the compression oracle, but it is not range-addressable by reference interval in this prototype.

sqlite_io_observation.note: Representative read-only process-level SQLite pread64 trace rerun outside the ptrace-restricted sandbox; 19 page-sized reads and 1329 repeated 16-byte header checks were observed. Page-cache residency is not inferred.

construction.peak_rss_scope: whole benchmark process; per-phase RSS is intentionally not inferred on this tiny fixture

fixture_scale_warning: MICB/KIR3DL1 is a tiny two-locus fixture. Metadata and the fixed bootstrap dominate differently than chromosome-scale archives; no format winner should be declared from this run.

structural_improvement.evidence: 2 exact repeated chunk payload entries accounted for 100062 avoidable compressed bytes (49.9% of the measured baseline archive)
structural_improvement.name: exact content-addressed chunk deduplication
